meet.landingBody: Private calls on Zentico's own servers. Start a meeting and share the link with anyone in your workspace.
meet.invalidCode: That doesn't look like a meeting code. Codes look like abc-defg-hij.
meet.notConfiguredHint: Ask your administrator to connect a LiveKit server (LIVEKIT_URL, LIVEKIT_API_KEY and LIVEKIT_API_SECRET).
meet.connectFailed: We couldn't connect to the meeting server. Check your connection and try again.
meet.permissionDenied: Camera or microphone access is blocked. Allow it from the address bar and reload — you can still join without them.
meet.noDevices: No camera or microphone found. You can still join and use chat.
meet.noCamera: No camera found. You can join with audio only.
meet.noMic: No microphone found. Others won't be able to hear you.
meet.deviceBusy: Your camera or microphone is in use by another app.
meet.insecureContext: Camera and microphone need a secure (HTTPS) connection.
meet.audioBlocked: Your browser paused the call audio.
meet.chatUnread: Chat, {count, plural, one {# new message} other {# new messages}}
meet.chatEmpty: Messages are only visible to people in the call and disappear when it ends.
meet.leftDuplicate: You joined this meeting from another tab or device
meet.leftLost: You were disconnected from the meeting
